map.Braden量表评估压疮风险，6个维度评分（6-23分），分值越低风险越高。点击: The Braden Scale assesses pressure-injury risk across 6 dimensions (6-23); lower scores mean higher risk. Click dimension options to auto-score.
map.📖 查看「压疮风险 Braden 评分自动计算器 使用指南」: View "Braden Score (Pressure-Injury Risk) Calculator User Guide"
map.本工具按 Braden 护理评分量表逐项计分并分层，结果仅供参考，以护士床旁评估: This tool scores and stratifies per the Braden nursing scale item by item; for reference only, subject to the nurse's bedside assessment and signature.
map.患者压疮风险低，维持常规护理: Patient low pressure-injury risk; maintain routine care
map.15-18分：轻度风险 → 预防措施：定时翻身（q4h）、保护皮肤: 15-18: mild risk -> turn q4h, protect skin
map.13-14分：中度风险 → 预防措施：定时翻身（q2h）、使用减压床垫: 13-14: moderate risk -> turn q2h, use pressure-reduction mattress
map.10-12分：高度风险 → 预防措施：翻身q2h、气垫床、局部减压: 10-12: high risk -> turn q2h, air mattress, local relief
map.≤9分：极度风险 → 预防措施：翻身q1h、气垫床、加强营养支持: <=9: very high risk -> turn q1h, air mattress, nutritional support
map.卧床或 ICU 患者入院 24 小时内评分，≤18 分启动翻身 q2h 与减压床: Score bedridden or ICU patients within 24 h; <=18 triggers turning q2h and a pressure-reduction mattress.
map.术后制动或大小便失禁患者，潮湿与活动维度下降，动态复评调整护理级别。: Post-op immobilized or incontinent patients drop on moisture and activity; reassess dynamically to adjust care level.
map.营养风险筛查异常者，结合血清白蛋白与进食量上调风险并请营养科会诊。: Those with abnormal nutrition screening: raise risk by serum albumin and intake, consult nutrition.
map.复核一例卧床老人 Braden 评分: Review a bedridden elder Braden score
map.感知 3、潮湿 2、活动 1、移动 2、营养 2、摩擦 2，合计 12 分，判极: Sensation 3, moisture 2, activity 1, mobility 2, nutrition 2, friction 2, total 12, very high risk, matching ward assessment.
map.本工具能替代压疮评估单吗？: Can this tool replace the pressure-injury sheet?
map.不能，仅作维度核对，正式评分以护士床旁 Braden 量表与签字为准。: No; it only checks dimensions. Formal scoring follows the nurse's bedside Braden scale and signature.
map.18 分为高危界值，按高危管理并加强观察，结合临床实际。: 18 is the high-risk cutoff; manage as high-risk with closer observation, per clinical reality.
map.已发生 1 期压红是否还要评？: Continue scoring after a stage-1 redness?
map.要，发生损伤后继续评分监测进展并上报，同时启动局部减压与皮肤护理。: Yes; after injury keep scoring to monitor progression and report, while starting local relief and skin care.
